title: nf-core/deepmutscan pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must not include special characters

file1.errorMessage: file1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must be a FASTQ file (.fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz, .fq.gz)

file2.errorMessage: file2 must be provided and be a FASTQ file (.fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz, .fq.gz). nf-core/deepmutscan requires paired-end reads: the read-pair merging step (vsearch) is what gives the overlapping bases their recalculated quality.

type.errorMessage: type must be one of: input, output, wildtype

replicate.errorMessage: Replicate must be a positive integer
